reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read the war in Revelation's heaven as unfolding in the church militant or Roman world, not God's throne room, leaving heaven's perfect will intact.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible sets the petition for God's will to be done in heaven against Revelation's report of war breaking out there.

sides.snippet: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
sides.verseText: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

sides.snippet: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon.
sides.verseText: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
